notes.title: Unlighted v.1.2.1
notes.content:
Solved some minor bugs:


 The scanner did not render the mugs, paper or bottles.
 Mugs now can be placed on roombas.
 Sofia's poster now does not has any physics.

notes.title: Unlighted v.1.2.0 - Day 30 Update
notes.content:
Unlighted's 30th day update is here! This update improved the overall game performance, fixed several minor bugs and enabled controller support ;) 

General update listing:


 Removed some Memory Leaks that were slowing down the game performance.


 Improved camera settings to maintain quality and improve performance.


 Added several light guides and visual elements to improve the UX after appearing in certain places in the final path of the Umbral world. 

 Fixed multiple minor gameplay bugs.


 Fixed multiple minor UI bugs.


 Compatibility with controllers!

notes.title: Unlighted v.1.1.21
notes.content:
Minor Bug Fixing.
 Important bug solved: sometimes when signing the contract it won't load the Clock Scene, causing a block in the game progress.

notes.title: Unlighted v1.1.2
notes.content:
Patch day 7:


 Fixes to background music in hallways.
 Fixes in some lights bake.
 Arrangements in the credits.


This update comes with a demo more faithful to the final game. Extinguishers, rumbas and a thinking chair in each level. All that already in the demo!

notes.title: Unlighted v1.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the player could load the next tests, but not save its current position.
 Changes on some UX features.

notes.title: Update notes for Unlighted v1.1.0
notes.content:
Cambios realizados

Some bug fixing:



In LVL13, sometimes the panel looked on when it shouldn't be.


In the Umbral Alchemy dining room , sometimes the incinerator room would appear unloaded.


Some buttons in the light control room already appeared without having to turn on the light.


Some text without translation into English or Catalan.


The moving platform did not return to its original place if you deactivated the solar panel in the Umbral LVL3.



Some UX improvements.

notes.title: Unlighted Demo - Achievements & Optimization
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː There are 5 unique achievements for the Unlighted Demo, out now:

 What's going on?!? - For completing the demo, nothing special.
 It was fun! - For completing all minigames that are featured in each glass cabinet.
 Friends :) - For finding the hidden coconuts, where are they?
 Where is this place? It looks nice. - For finding the lost Sofia's poster, is it within our world?
 Faster than the light! - For completing the Speedrun Mode in 2:40 minutes or less.


ːsteamthisː Furthermore, we made some performance improvements! Specially in LVL6 ːsteamthisː
